name: Time Breaking: Dino Breach
description:
About This Game

Time Breaking: Dino Breach is an isometric survival horror inspired by Dino Crisis.

With gameplay that echoes the intense survival dynamics and tension of the classic Dino Crisis, Time Breaking: Dino Breach offers a mix of action, puzzle-solving and moments of pure suspense as you explore claustrophobic research centers and prehistoric jungles populated by deadly dinosaurs.

Key Gameplay Features:

  • Live a gripping and emotional story: Step into the role of Kate Jeong, a R.O.P.E soldier who travels back in time to change the tragic fate of Alan, a person she deeply loves. But what will be the consequences of her choices?

  • Explore dangerous environments: Navigate hostile prehistoric jungles and claustrophobic research centers in search of resources, weapons, and key items that can mean the difference between life and death.

  • Face deadly dinosaurs: Engage in tense and fear-filled battles with dangerous dinosaurs whose behaviors are inspired by those found in Dino Crisis. Use your wits and carefully manage limited ammunition to defeat or escape them.

  • Solve puzzles and riddles: Solve puzzles and environmental riddles to progress, unlock weapon upgrades, and find useful tools to survive the ravenous dinosaurs.
short_desc: Time Breaking: Dino Breach is an isometric survival horror inspired by the unforgettable Dino Crisis. Experience the desperate struggle of Kate Jeong, a woman who travels back in time, facing dangerous dinosaurs, determined to change the fate of someone she deeply loves.
